analysis: The trial crashed after 3.22 allocated GPU-seconds and produced no validation score. The supplied traceback only reports that train.py exited unsuccessfully; it does not expose the underlying exception. The code requires REMAINING_GPU_SECONDS, so an absent or invalid value is a possible failure point, but this is unconfirmed. No evidence establishes whether full-history reconstruction improves over the previously reported 0.6225 withheld-target variant or 0.6250 reference.
code_summary: Four category-specific ensembles combine residual MultVAE and SASRec through equal-weight mean-rank fusion. MultVAE uses a 256-dimensional encoder and 64-dimensional latent representation, retaining roughly half each history as context while reconstructing every original history item with multinomial NLL plus annealed KL. SASRec retains two attention blocks, 50-dimensional embeddings, and one-negative BCE. Independent expert seeds remain 42; supplied splits and dataset routing remain unchanged. Training selects checkpoints using validation metrics, exports working/predict.py, and includes checkpoint-reload and predictor-parity checks; their completion is unverified because the run crashed.
